usageNotes: Returns the directory index of sub-resources available under a specific replication job on a node — useful for discovering what child endpoints (e.g. log, schedule, status) are exposed for a given job. The replication job must exist on the specified node; use `get_nodes_node_replication` first to list valid job IDs. Accessible by all authenticated users since permissions are set to 'user: all'.

examples.summary: List sub-resources for replication job 101-0 on node pve1

tips: The job ID format is '<GUEST_ID>-<JOBNUM>' (e.g. '101-0'), where the guest ID is a 3–9 digit VM or CT ID and the job number starts at 0.
This endpoint is a directory index — it returns an array of child resource names (e.g. 'log', 'schedule', 'status'), not job configuration or status data directly.
To inspect actual replication status or logs, follow up with the child endpoints returned by this call.
